effects.l1: Gentle breeze: destroy a chair-sized wooden object.
effects.l2: Sudden gust: destroy doors, scaffolding, beams.
effects.l3: Sudden quake: destroy large stone objects; lower effects work on stone.
effects.l4: Scourge of steel: destroy anvil-sized metal objects; lower effects work on metal.

system.description: Shatter objects and structures by striking their weak point. Any level: + Tao level damage (paid in Chi). Adds Tao level to Metal Tests to break a weapon held with Trap.
